chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Take a-way, take a-way, / take one off, what do we say? / Count what's left, one by one, / take a-way is so much fun!

v1.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v1.lyrics: Five lit-tle cup-cakes, pink and sweet, / a bun-ny ate one, what a treat! / Count what's left, one, two, three, four, / five take a-way one is four!

v2.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v2.lyrics: Four lit-tle frogs up-on a log, / one jumped in, splash, in the bog! / Count what's left, one, two, three, / four take a-way one is three!

v3.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v3.lyrics: Three red bal-loons up in the air, / pop goes one, now two are there! / Count what's left, one, two, / three take a-way one is two!

v4.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v4.lyrics: Two lit-tle birds up in a tree, / one flew a-way, so sing with me! / Count what's left, just one, / two take a-way one is one!

v5.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v5.lyrics: One lit-tle cook-ie on the plate, / I ate it up, it tast-ed great! / Count what's left, oh no, there's none, / one take a-way one is ze-ro!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q1.lyrics: What is three take a-way one? / Two!

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q2.lyrics: What is five take a-way two? / Three!

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: What is four take a-way four? / Ze-ro!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: What is two take a-way one? / One!

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Hold up five fin-gers, wig-gle them all, / fold one down, now four stand tall! / Fold one more, now three, then two, / one, then ze-ro, peek-a-boo!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's take a-way slow-ly! / Three take a-way one / Two! / Two take a-way one / One!
